terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: Orthographic-like front elevation; review with a long lens (20 deg) from slightly above so the collar floor and disc caps read. Not solved: no projection route.

objectClass.primaryType: capsule-toy vending machine (gashapon), stylized toon illustration
objectClass.notes: Glass sphere dome on a rounded-cuboid housing; a disc medallion carrying the mascot decal on top; ten two-tone capsule spheres inside; crank disc with bar+knob and a recessed tray on the front face. Toon look: black outline + white sticker halo on every part. Source is an illustration, so output is explicitly stylized; depth is inferred.

reasoning: Silhouette is a sphere stacked on a rounded box with a small disc on top: simple outline (1).
Visible subparts: dome, collar, body, medallion, 10 capsules, sign, crank disc, crank bar, knob, tray (2).
Hierarchy: machine > body > front-face parts > crank > bar > knob is three levels (2).
One repeated system: capsules, 10 instances in 5 colours (1).
Eleven distinct flat materials but no layered wear; one decal (medallion) and one text decal (2).
Local detail is limited to outlines, one glass highlight, capsule seams and highlights (1).
Only the back face, body depth and tray interior are hidden; inferable by symmetry (1).
Interactive: crank must rotate about its axle, one capsule must leave the dome and land in the tray; capsules need colliders (2).

specDepthDecision.rationale: Moderate: ~10 parts, one instanced capsule system, decals as local overrides, a crank pivot and a drop socket for interaction.

detailInventory.note: Scanned zone by zone over di-zones/; every detail maps to a component.localFeatures or material.localOverrides entry.

details.description: Circular mascot image (Yellow Jack) on a yellow disc inside a white ring + black ring; the sticker frame has a black outline.
One painted white ellipse 0.23 D x 0.11 D rotated -30 deg, upper-front-lateral on the dome; the only strong specular cue.
Uniform black outline (~0.013 D) plus a white sticker halo (~0.013 D) outside it on every part boundary and silhouette; the dome rim shows three concentric rings (black, white, black).
details.affects: outline pass (inverted hull), rim torus geometry on the dome

details.description: Black equatorial line splitting each capsule into a coloured top hemisphere and a white bottom hemisphere.
details.affects: two-material sphere, thin dark ring geometry at the equator

details.description: Small white inset highlight upper-left on every capsule top hemisphere (gloss plastic).
details.affects: roughness 0.3, specular hotspot aligned to key light

details.description: Light blue-grey flat band where the dome meets the body: the capsule floor/collar cup, 0.95 D wide, 0.06 D tall, with a lighter top lip.
Yellow rounded rectangle 0.48 D x 0.13 D rotated -2 deg with black display-face text 'JACK GACHA'; has physical thickness (sticker edge) and a black outline.
details.affects: thin raised plate + canvas text texture

details.description: Pink rounded bar 0.21 D x 0.05 D with a black sphere knob 0.07 D at its lateral end, on a white disc 0.28 D; the disc has a black outline. Rotates about the disc centre.
details.affects: three separate solids, pivot at disc centre

details.description: Dark near-black rounded rectangle 0.25 D x 0.17 D at the lower-left of the front face with a lighter inner lip along its top edge: the capsule exit chute.
details.affects: real recess into the body, cavity material

details.description: All body and tray corners are rounded (radius ~0.08 D body, ~0.03 D tray); the dome rim and medallion ring are fully round.

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

definitionOfDone: Front view at 10 deg pitch reads as the reference: glass sphere (D) on a rounded off-white housing (1.1 D x 0.72 D), medallion disc on top, ten two-tone capsules resting on a blue-grey collar floor.
Every part carries a black outline with a white sticker halo (inverted-hull outline pass); the dome shows one strong specular ellipse upper-front-left.
Crank disc, bar and knob are separate solids that rotate together about the disc centre; one capsule can be released from the dome and land in the tray recess.
Capsules are an instanced system of 10 with exactly five colours (pink, mint, sky, grape, yellow) and a black equatorial seam.
Stylized/toon output; no photoreal PBR wear is expected.

featureGroups.name: Glass dome sphere
qualityCriteria: A full sphere of diameter D, transmissive (transmission ~0.9, roughness 0.05, slight blue tint), with a visible rim torus (black/white/black) at the collar seam and one specular ellipse upper-front-left.
failureModes: no rim ring where the sphere meets the collar
highlight missing or on the wrong side

featureGroups.name: Two-tone capsule instances
qualityCriteria: Ten spheres of 0.19 D in two rows resting on the collar floor inside the dome, coloured top hemisphere + white bottom + black seam ring, five colours distributed as in the reference, glossy (roughness 0.3) with a highlight.
failureModes: capsules floating or intersecting the dome
fewer than 10 or wrong colour set

featureGroups.name: Rounded housing with collar and tray
qualityCriteria: Off-white rounded cuboid 1.1 D x 0.72 D x 0.75 D (inferred depth), fillet 0.08 D, a blue-grey collar cup 0.95 D wide at the top, and a 0.25 D x 0.17 D recessed tray at front-lower-left with a dark cavity material.
failureModes: tray painted on instead of recessed
collar missing so the sphere floats on the box

featureGroups.name: Crank disc, bar and knob
qualityCriteria: White disc 0.28 D protruding 0.03 D from the front face at 0.55 body height, pink bar 0.21 D x 0.05 D with rounded ends, black sphere knob 0.07 D at the lateral end; bar + knob pivot about the disc axis.
failureModes: bar centred on the disc instead of offset

featureGroups.name: Medallion and sign decals
qualityCriteria: Medallion: 0.39 D disc on top of the dome, yellow face with the mascot image texture, white ring + black ring frame. Sign: yellow plate 0.48 D x 0.13 D rotated -2 deg with black 'JACK GACHA' text on the front face under the collar.
failureModes: sign text unreadable at the review distance

featureGroups.name: Sticker outline language
qualityCriteria: Every part has a black outline ~0.013 D and a white halo ~0.013 D (inverted-hull or post-process outline); toon shading with flat albedo and a single key light up-front-left casting a hard offset contact shadow.
failureModes: smooth PBR shading with no outline, losing the sticker identity

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision must inspect a side-by-side reference/render sheet and score the current pass from 0 to 1. Pixel-diff code may assist diagnostics but cannot approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: single-image extraction is reference-derived inference, not exact photogrammetry
referencePbrExtraction.skipReason: The reference is a flat-colour toon illustration: every material is a solid fill (rule: solid albedo for flat paint). Scalar PBR values are set per material from sampled hex fills; see spec.risks and materials[].textureless.

mustAvoid: plastic-looking smooth bark, stone, cloth, foliage, or aged material
local color/detail described only in prose without material masks
claiming exact PBR recovery when confidence is below the target threshold
reference lighting copied without separating material readability

screenshotReview: Compare albedo palette and local color zones.
Compare cavity dirt, edge wear, stains, moss, scratches, or other local masks.
Compare key/fill/rim structure, exposure, tone mapping, background, and contact shadows.
Capture a neutral-light render to verify material readability without reference lighting.
Capture a grazing-light close-up to expose flat normals, uniform roughness, tiling, and plastic highlights.
Capture a reference-matched render from the same camera framing as the source.

actionReadiness.contract: Every macro/meso component should be generated as a stable named Object3D pivot node with a mesh child, action metadata, optional sockets, collider proxy, and destruction metadata.
requiredComponentFields: attachment for child appendages, connectors, limbs, tubes, handles, legs, horns, wings, branches, or cables
authoringRules: Do not collapse independently movable parts into one mesh.
Put transforms on component pivot groups, not only on raw meshes.
For attached child parts, put the pivot at the semantic root/socket and build visible geometry from localStart to localEnd.
Represent hinge, socket, detachable, and breakable intent even when no animation is implemented yet.
Use simplified collider proxies for runtime physics instead of visual mesh colliders by default.

destructionPolicy.fractureGroupNaming: Use stable semantic names such as body-shell, left-hinge, glass-panel, branch-segment.
destructionPolicy.debrisStrategy: Prefer detachable component groups and a small number of procedural fragments over random mesh explosion.

assumptions: Housing depth 0.75 D is inferred (front view only); back face is plain.
The dome is a full sphere whose bottom 0.08 D sinks into the housing top; the reference cannot distinguish this from a hemisphere on a cup.
The medallion is a separate coin disc standing on the sphere with its face toward +Z, rising 0.2 D above the dome and overlapping the glass by 0.19 D (px 25..280 vs dome top 155).
The tray opening is approximated as a dark plate at blockout/structural passes; a real recess is a form-refinement hand edit.
Two-tone capsules and the black seam are realised at hand-refinement by splitting each SphereGeometry at the equator; the generator emits single-colour spheres.
The mascot image is a supplied texture (docs/assets/mascot.jpg) applied to the medallion cap at hand-refinement; the generator emits a yellow cap.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Hero prop on a landing page: keep under 60k triangles and 60 draw calls after outline shells; instance capsules if draw calls exceed budget.

lightingFromPhoto.direction: upper-front-left (from the viewer's left, ~35 deg elevation, ~30 deg left of the view axis)
lightingFromPhoto.evidence: glass highlight ellipse upper-left; capsule highlights upper-left; drop shadow offset lower-right
no dark side on any part; toon flat fills
hard offset contact shadow / ground shadow under the housing and dome rim; small ambient occlusion only at the dome seam, tray mouth and under the crank disc
needed for the transmissive dome to read as glass (a warm studio room environment, no visible HDRI detail)
flat toon value range: exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping keeps the saturated fills from clipping; shadow softness 0 (hard offset) to match the sticker drop shadow

proceduralStrategy: Block out the stack: rounded housing box, glass sphere, medallion coin, sign plate, crank disc, tray plate.
Add the ten capsule spheres inside the dome, the floor cup, the crank bar + knob, the medallion ring.
Hand-refine: split capsules into two hemispheres + seam, text canvas on the sign, mascot texture on the medallion cap, optional real tray recess.
Material pass: flat toon fills, transmissive dome, gloss capsules; lighting pass: key up-front-left, warm fill, environment map, contact shadow; add inverted-hull outline shells.
Interaction pass: crank rotor pivot (+Z), capsule detach path from the dome floor through the housing to the trayMouth socket.
animationAnchors: root pivot node supports whole-object translation, rotation, scale, and visibility changes
component pivot groups support later local transforms without rebuilding geometry
destructionAnchors: actionProfile.destruction.fractureGroup marks detachable or breakable component sets
component seams and sockets define plausible break points instead of random explosions
risks: Transmission on the dome needs an environment map or the glass reads milky; lighting-pass must add one.
Inverted-hull outlines double the draw calls; budget 60 draw calls assumes capsules are merged or instanced.
The generator cannot emit split hemispheres, text canvases, image decals or boolean recesses: four hand-refinement edits that must be carried back into this spec's localOverrides/localFeatures notes.
